text:
jordan: Heads up — seeing a sudden spike of fncall validator rejects in prod and the billing dashboards are lighting up for several customers. example log: `invoke.validate: reject tool_response schema: missing \"result\" field`

sre-bot: alert: fncall-validator-reject-rate elevated for cluster-prod-eu-west (sampling=1%)

lee: did we flip the strict validator canary last night?

ash: yep, rolled strict-validate v2 at 02:10 UTC, canary -> 50% -> 100% around 07:50. I thought billing was gated but hmm.

maria: why would a validation reject correlate with billed tokens? rejects should be no-cost or at least not double-counted.

jordan: that's the weird part — metric stream shows tokens_billed on the reject path. sample: `tokens_billed=42` in the same event as `validation=reject`.

ops: customers are seeing unexpected charges, we got 3 PM tickets from cust-acme within the hour.

ash: digging: validator does early parsing and we increment token counter at request start, then later validator sets reject; I thought we subtract on reject but seems route_id is null in that code path so billing service treats it as anonymous and attributes to caller default.

lee: console: per-route token chart shows big spike because route_id is missing and falls into the catch-all route. billing alert fired.

maria: can we short-term suppress billing alerts while we fix? we should avoid noise if real cost impact is under investigation.

ops: suppressing alerts is fine for now but we need a bugfix ASAP. Also communicate to billing before noisy emails go out.

jordan: paste of the problematic log snippet:
```
2026-03-20T14:02:01Z invoke_id=8f7c validator=fncall strict=true result=reject reason=missing_field route_id=null tokens_billed=42
2026-03-20T14:02:01Z billing_event invoke_id=8f7c customer_id=cust-acme attributed_route=__unattributed__ amount_usd=0.0032
```

ash: reproduction locally: when validator rejects during post-kv-cache handshake the request context loses `route_id`. patch idea: attach route_id to the grpc metadata earlier (before validation) and add a fail-safe `do_not_bill_if_validation_reject` flag in billing client.

lee: long-term: console should show a metric: `rejected_fncall_billed_ratio` and split strict vs soft rejects, plus a panel for rejects-by-reason. adds signal for rollout safety.

maria: add rollout checklist item: monitor `reject:billed_ratio` and `reject:by_reason` during canary -> 100% rollouts. Also ensure cust-facing billing gating.

ash: I'll open a hotfix PR for the metadata attach + guard flag. Target: hosted patch same-day, dedicated patch next maintenance window.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: hotfix/attach-routeid -> prod-canary scheduled 15:10 UTC (sha: a1b2c3).

ops: can we also backfill missed events into telemetry so we can quantify how many billed rejects in last 24h?

jordan: yes, need sampling logs + original invoke_id list. add `sampling:validator_reject` to telemetry and export to kinesis for backfill.

sre-bot: created incident INC-2026-03-20-01: "fncall validator rejects causing billed-unattributed events"

maria: affected customers noted: cust-acme, cust-zen, cust-labs. ops please prep a private FYI before we send any public comms.

lee: will add dashboard tile: "Rejected FNCalls (billed) by reason" and an alert when billed rejects > 5% of rejects for 5m.

ash: quick note — this also explains some churn in Dedicated capacity accounting; unattributed tokens were getting counted against pooled buckets. patch will stop the null-route attribution.

ops: ok, timeline? hotfix -> canary in 30m, monitor for 1h, then promote?

ash: yes. PR coming in 5m. I'll also add a feature-flag to switch validator to soft-mode for specific customers if needed.

jordan: thanks. after patch let's run a backfill and validation: compute `sum(tokens_billed where validation_reject)/sum(total_rejects)` pre- and post-patch and push to console.

maria: putting a note in the rollout playbook: "ensure route_id is present on all early-exit paths (validation, auth, preflight)".

ops: thumbs up :thumbsup:
